newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index stagnates at 99.642 pts.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index stagnates at 99.642 pts.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds remained unchanged in Thursday's trading at 99.642 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.001 points to 2.307 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, stagnated at 95.811 points, the bank said, while the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.401 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 0.485 points to 1,193.046.
